spans.s: Caṇḍa-pracaṇḍa (SITI), divinities guarding the inner shrine of a Viṣṇu temple.
Caṇḍeśvara (SITI), traditional executive of Śiva temples; also called Ādi-dāsa.
Caṇḍeśvara-pperuvilai (SITI), Sanskrit-Tamil; literally, the sale-price of Caṇḍeśvara, the traditional executive of Śiva temples; actually, sale-price of land purchased from a Śiva temple.
